versions.content: Semantics of EcucUriReferenceDef Meta-class Ecu- cUriReferenceDef is used to support the definition of an URI-based reference. De- tailed constraints regarding the possible targets of the URI-based reference are spec- ified in the scope of the aggregation of EcucDestinationUriPolicy in the role destinationUriPolicy . The existence of an URI-base reference is established by • an EcucContainerDef that references EcucDestinationUriDef in the role destinationUri in order to indicate that it wants to become the target of an URI-based reference and • an EcucUriReferenceDef that references EcucDestinationUriDef in the role destinationUri to represent the owner of the URI-based reference .
